question: The Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Hardeep Singh Puri, in October 2022 inaugurated Asia's largest Compressed Bio Gas (CBG) plant in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Asia's largest Compressed Bio Gas:-**

 
 
• The Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Hardeep Singh Puri, in October 2022 inaugurated Asia's largest Compressed Bio Gas (CBG) plant in Sangrur, Punjab.** (Hence option 1 is correct)**
 
• The plant is spread across an area of 20 acres and has been commissioned with an FDI investment of approximately Rs. 220 crores.
 
• The plant's present production is about 6 tonnes per day, but it will soon use 8 digesters with a combined capacity of 10,000 cubic metres to process 300 tons of paddy straw each day.
 
• The plant is expected **to generate employment for over 1,000 people **and **will help to reduce air pollution by converting agricultural waste into clean fuel.**
 
• It will also help to reduce India's dependence on imported fossil fuels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Compressed Bio Gas:-**

 
 
• **CBG plant is a facility that produces biogas and compresses it to natural gas quality.**
 
• Biogas is a renewable energy source that is produced by the anaerobic digestion of organic matter, such as agricultural waste, municipal solid waste, and sewage treatment plant waste.
